Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning a sales and use tax exemption for bait used by a fishing charter business.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a sales and use tax exemption for bait used bya fishing charter business; adding a new section to chapter 82.08 RCW;adding a new section to chapter 82.12 RCW; creating a new section; andproviding an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to the sale of bait purchased bya qualifying buyer for use on a vessel subject to a salmon or nonsalmoncharter license under RCW 77.65.150. (2) The exemption is available only when the buyer provides theseller with an exemption certificate in a form and manner prescribed bythe department. The seller must retain a copy of the certificate forthe seller's files. (3) For the purposes of this section, "qualifying buyer" means aperson holding a salmon or nonsalmon charter license under RCW77.65.150 or a charter booking service.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The provisions of this chapter do not apply to the use by aqualifying buyer of bait for use on a vessel subject to a salmon ornonsalmon charter license under RCW 77.65.150. "Qualifying buyer" hasthe same meaning as provided in section 1 of this act.
This act applies retroactively as well asprospectively; however, taxpayers may not seek a refund for sales oruse taxes that have already been paid.
